Category palette across every installed theme

The 17 allowlist tokens as the three marks the app really paints them as - a 36px tile, an 8px dot and a bar - beside the 13 categories a real account shows. Every figure is measured by frontend/src/lib/themeGuard.ts; the contrast column follows the switcher.

Contrast is WCAG against each theme's own base-100 card. Only three tokens clear 3:1 in every theme, which is structural rather than a defect - see COLOUR_CONTRAST in backend/src/database/central/template-tokens.ts.

The 13 categories a real account shows

The 12 onboarding templates plus the Uncategorized fallback, which is seeded at provisioning rather than being a template - which is why this repo says "thirteen seeded categories" where CATEGORY_SEED holds 12. This is the half that came from category-colors-icons-description-preview.html.

  • Groceries

    success · shopping-basket

  • Dining out

    secondary · utensils

  • Transportation

    info · car

  • Utilities

    accent · zap

  • Healthcare

    error · heart-pulse

  • Entertainment

    primary · tv

  • Education

    primary-content · graduation-cap

  • Travel

    secondary-content · plane

  • Personal care

    accent-content · scissors

  • Gifts

    success-content · gift

  • Family & pets

    info-content · paw-print

  • Loans & debt

    warning · landmark

  • Uncategorized

    base-content/50 · circle-question-mark

    Seeded at provisioning, not a template. Offered on no screen.
